gleeok.getSnapshot().then(s => { const w = s.state.windows.find(x => x.role === 'main'); gleeok.dispatch({ type: 'setPaneWeights', winId: w.id, weights: { 0: 1.6, 1: 0.6, 2: 0.8 } }); return 'weights set'; })

(() => { const p = document.querySelector('.panes > .pane'); const cs = getComputedStyle(p); return 'transition: ' + cs.transitionProperty + ' ' + cs.transitionDuration + ' | grow ' + cs.flexGrow + ' | hidden ' + document.hidden + ' | visibility ' + document.visibilityState; })()
